title: Engine: Ready to Assign never exceeds cash; hiding or deleting a category never changes any number (absorbs budget-c8vy)
description: See budget-c8vy for the diagnosed cause (client zeroSum.ts buildLedgers: uncategorized or orphaned credit-card legs fund nothing and do not reduce RTA until the month rollover sweep). Also: hiding a category changed RTA in production (76.070,88 -> 75.545,89), so some total drops hidden categories. Fix at engine level with regression tests.
notes: REVIEW (orchestrator) 2026-11-27: accepted on my side after two independent reviews (round 1: 3 money bugs found and fixed; round 2: engine core passed the reviewer's own tests incl. a 5,400-check property; 5 follow-ups N1,N2,N3,N5,N6 fixed in round 4). Checks run by me on the branch: shared 217, client 1573, api 1713 pass/1 skip/0 fail, tsc clean. Open owner decision: uncategorized spending charged at once vs next month (cashUncategorized / cardUncategorized in domain/zeroSum.ts are the two switches).
acceptance_criteria: Engine tests: (1) card spend with category null, (2) card spend on a soft-deleted category, (3) hiding a category with assigned money and activity, (4) deleting one: in every case and every month, sum(on-budget cash balances) = readyToAssign + sum(category available incl. payment envelopes and the uncategorized bucket), readyToAssign <= cash, and hide/unhide leaves every figure identical. Whole-budget property test over random ledgers. typecheck+lint+test green.
